findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian `totpStep1` value was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users of the account theme will see an Italian sentence. It should be a Lithuanian translation, or the key should be removed so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle now reads "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction on the OTP setup page. Use a Lithuanian string, or drop the key so the English fallback is used.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle gets Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new zh_CN `totpStep1` value "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：" is written in Traditional Chinese characters (zh_TW style). The rest of the file uses Simplified Chinese, so users will see mixed scripts. It should be something like "在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：".

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax introduced into i18next-based bundle
findings.body: This bundle uses i18next interpolation (`{{0}}`, `{{name}}`), as every other key in the file does. The new `error-invalid-multivalued-size` value uses Java MessageFormat placeholders (`{0}`) and a ChoiceFormat expression (`{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`). i18next will not substitute these, so the account console will show the raw placeholder text to users. Keep the `{{n}}` syntax and use i18next pluralization instead. The same problem applies to the identical change in `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties`.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message lacks key and file
findings.body: The "Didn't find anchor tag ..." message does not say which key or file is affected, unlike the duplicate-key and Illegal HTML messages. When the verifier runs over hundreds of bundles, maintainers cannot locate the offending translation. Include `key` and `file` in the message.

findings.title: ANCHOR_PATTERN matches any tag starting with 'a'
findings.body: `</?a[^>]*>` also matches tags such as `<abbr>`, `<address>` or `<area>`, not only `<a ...>`. Those tags would be treated as anchors and compared against the English anchors, producing misleading "Didn't find anchor tag" errors. Require a word boundary, e.g. `</?a(\s[^>]*)?>`.

findings.title: Missing English bundle throws RuntimeException instead of a reported failure
findings.body: If the derived English file does not exist, `verifySafeHtml` throws a bare RuntimeException. This happens for files without a locale suffix, or when the path regex derives the wrong name. The exception bypasses the `MojoExecutionException` handling in `verify()`, so the build fails with an unclear stack trace instead of a reported verification error. Throw a `MojoExecutionException`, or report the problem as a message.

findings.title: No positive test and weakened duplicate-key assertion
findings.body: Every test only checks that some error is reported. None verifies that a valid bundle, such as an allowed `<b>` in a translation whose English source also contains `<b>`, produces no messages, so false positives would go unnoticed. The duplicate-key assertion was also loosened from `contains` to `hasItem`, so unexpected extra errors for that fixture are no longer caught.
